description: Land Title Settlement Department - Mabodala, Minuwangoda D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510401
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed information about parcel numbers, extents, owners' names and identities, and title classifications. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses entirely on land ownership and title settlement matters, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
